title: Security Fastlane: Attestation Tokens + Pricing Hooks to Reduce SIG/CAIQ Turnaround
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Sales and legal report multi-week slippage on enterprise contracts due to heavy SIG/CAIQ evidence collection. Repeated manual responses for the same platform assertions increase cost of closed-won deals and create friction for mid-market customers. Goal: reduce time-to-contract and assessor effort by offering a 'Security Fastlane' that pairs machine-readable attestation tokens + curated evidence packs with targeted pricing/packaging incentives.

Scope: 1) Define an attestation token format and minimal evidence pack that covers 60% of common SIG/CAIQ items for SMB/mid-market deals. 2) Prototype a pricing hook (security-response credit) that applies when a customer accepts the attestation + limited audit. 3) Run a controlled experiment with sales cohorts (self-serve vs. AE-assisted) measuring turnaround, deal velocity, and legal touchpoints. 4) Integrate token issuance flow into onboarding console and account team playbooks.

Hypothesis: Bundling pre-signed attestation tokens with a conditional pricing credit will reduce average questionnaire turnaround from 18 days to <=7 days for target segment and increase win rate for quota-attended opportunities by 5-8%.

Success metrics: - Median SIG/CAIQ completion time (days) - # of follow-up evidence requests per questionnaire - Deal win rate lift for cohort - Customer satisfaction score with security onramp - Number of false-positive security escalations to SRE/legal

Deliverables: - Attestation token spec and issuer process - 3 curated evidence packs (SMB, Mid, Enterprise-light) + storage links - Pricing credit definition and billing implementation plan - Sales/Legal playbook + template language - Console UX wireframe for token acceptance and evidence download - Experiment plan and dashboard queries
comments: 2025-11-28 - Kickoff: PM, Legal, Sales Ops, Security, and Platform attended. Agreed on target segments (ARR < $500k and 'mid-market light' deals). Action: PM to draft attestation scope and savings model.

2025-11-30 - Legal note: Attestations should be cryptographically signed and versioned. Must include explicit retention policy and revocation workflow. Legal will supply required clause language. Action: Security to propose token format.

2025-12-01 - Security (Sanjay) delivered initial token prototype: JSON Web Signature (JWS) containing canonicalized control IDs, issue_date, expiry, and domain. Needs HSM/KMS integration for signing in Private deployments. Action: Engineering estimate requested.

2025-12-02 - Design review: Console flow sketched for 'Accept Attestation and Claim Security Credit' modal. Suggest inline evidence preview and explicit FAQ. Action: Design to produce high-fidelity mockups by 2025-12-10.

2025-12-03 - Engineering scoping: Backend work (token issuer endpoint, audit log, revocation list) estimated 3 backend pts + 2 frontend pts. Billing team flags need for billing event and invoice annotation for credits. Action: ENG to add as dependency and surface API changes.

2025-12-04 - Experiment plan drafted: Two cohorts (A: AE-assisted + credit, B: AE-assisted without credit). Holdout for self-serve lane. Metrics and dashboard queries assigned to Analytics (ticket: ENG-42901). Next step: legal approval on sample attestation wording.

Next steps: - Finalize token spec with Security & Legal (due 2025-12-11). - Design mockups and copy (due 2025-12-10). - Engineering kickoff to schedule sprint work (estimate 2 sprints). - Prepare experiment instrumentation and SQL metrics for pre/post analysis.
